arguments.query: automated secret scanning source code repository

answer:c178e207-69fc-45d2-b55a-c42c6c494: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:6dd69277-2734-4d45-81fc-905b1aebd: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:bf7ed9df-4af3-4678-9cda-0b8e28c15: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:faf261d0-a997-40ea-be66-4c757a0cc: Yes. Customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 with keys managed by our cloud provider's key management service.
answer:f7986f43-b3b6-4bb6-aa75-1b325909c: Yes. New EBS disks in our AWS account (111122223333) are encrypted by default.
